description: This file contains functions and data structures related to reading, parsing, and comparing Git tree objects, including traversal utilities and comparison functions for directory entries.

methods.name: int read_tree_at(struct repository * r,struct tree * tree,struct strbuf * base,int depth,const struct pathspec * pathspec,read_tree_fn_t fn,void * context)
methods.description: Recursively reads entries from a tree object in a repository, applying a callback function to each entry; supports maximum depth and submodule handling.

methods.name: int read_tree(struct repository * r,struct tree * tree,const struct pathspec * pathspec,read_tree_fn_t fn,void * context)
methods.description: Initializes and calls read_tree_at to read a tree in a repository starting from the root.

methods.name: int base_name_compare(const char * name1,size_t len1,int mode1,const char * name2,size_t len2,int mode2)
methods.description: Compares two directory entry names, considering directory status for sorting.

methods.name: int df_name_compare(const char * name1,size_t len1,int mode1,const char * name2,size_t len2,int mode2)
methods.description: Similar to base_name_compare but treats directory and file entries as equal when names are identical, with nuanced ordering.

methods.name: int name_compare(const char * name1,size_t len1,const char * name2,size_t len2)
methods.description: Basic comparison of two names based on memcmp.

methods.name: struct:tree * lookup_tree(struct repository * r,const struct object_id * oid)
methods.description: Looks up or creates a tree object in the repository given its object id.

methods.name: int parse_tree_buffer(struct tree * item,void * buffer,unsigned long size)
methods.description: Attaches a buffer to a tree object, marking it as parsed.

methods.name: int parse_tree_gently(struct tree * item,int quiet_on_missing)
methods.description: Reads and parses a tree object from disk, handling errors gracefully.

methods.name: void free_tree_buffer(struct tree * tree)
methods.description: Frees the buffer associated with a tree object.

methods.name: struct:tree * parse_tree_indirect(const struct object_id * oid)
methods.description: Peels an object to a tree type based on its object id, returning the tree object.

ctags.signature: (const char * name1,size_t len1,int mode1,const char * name2,size_t len2,int mode2)

ctags.pattern: /^int df_name_compare(const char *name1, size_t len1, int mode1,$/
ctags.signature: (const char * name1,size_t len1,int mode1,const char * name2,size_t len2,int mode2)

ctags.signature: (const char * name1,size_t len1,const char * name2,size_t len2)
